mapper.sql: prescription.id, prescription.register_id AS registration_id, prescription.drug_id, drug.drug_code, drug.drug_name, drug.drug_format, drug.drug_unit, prescription.drug_usage, prescription.drug_number, prescription.state, prescription.created_at, prescription.dispensed_at, prescription.dispensed_by, drug_stock.quantity AS stock_quantity
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prescription LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = prescription.drug_id LEFT JOIN drug_stock ON drug_stock.drug_id = prescription.drug_id WHERE prescription.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM prescription LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = prescription.drug_id LEFT JOIN drug_stock ON drug_stock.drug_id = prescription.drug_id
ORDER BY prescription.created_at, prescription.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prescription LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = prescription.drug_id
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET state = 'DISPENSED', dispensed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, dispensed_by = #{dispensedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'PAID'
UPDATE prescription SET state = 'RETURNED' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'DISPENSED'
